ARG MC_VERSIONS="1.21.11 1.21.8 1.21.4 1.21.1"

# Nxeon research toolchain so the image never depends on a moving download.
COPY toolchain.tgz /tmp/toolchain.tgz
RUN mkdir -p /opt/mb && tar xzf /tmp/toolchain.tgz -C /opt/mb && rm /tmp/toolchain.tgz \
 && ln -s /opt/mb/jdk-21.0.12.1+1 /opt/mb/jdk && ln -s /opt/mb/gradle-8.14.3 /opt/mb/gradle
ENV JAVA_HOME=/opt/mb/jdk
ENV PATH=/opt/mb/jdk/bin:/opt/mb/gradle/bin:$PATH

# compile versions whose registry entry is `buildable` with javaRelease 25. All args are EMPTY by default, so the
# default image is exactly the 1.21.x image. Everything is verified by sha256; a URL without its checksum fails the build.
#   docker build --build-arg JDK25_URL=https://github.com/adoptium/temurin25-binaries/releases/download/jdk-25.0.4.1%2B1/OpenJDK25U-jdk_x64_linux_hotspot_25.0.4.1_1.tar.gz \
#     --build-arg JDK25_SHA256=dbb698396d478e7fa2b1e50f4103324b2a99b90569ee27c33f2261f9215cf41e \
#     --build-arg GRADLE9_URL=https://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-9.8.1-bin.zip \
#     --build-arg GRADLE9_SHA256=dce76f55f8e251a3a1f130eb120f30b3d271de2b76c9b0729d316b5a1b6dc01f \

ARG JDK25_SHA256=""
ARG GRADLE9_URL=""
ARG GRADLE9_SHA256=""
ARG MC26_PINS=""

      test -n "$JDK25_SHA256" && curl -fsSL -o /tmp/jdk25.tgz "$JDK25_URL" && echo "$JDK25_SHA256  /tmp/jdk25.tgz" | sha256sum -c - \
      && mkdir -p /opt/mb/jdk25 && tar xzf /tmp/jdk25.tgz -C /opt/mb/jdk25 --strip-components=1 && rm /tmp/jdk25.tgz && /opt/mb/jdk25/bin/javac -version; \

    if [ -n "$GRADLE9_URL" ]; then \

      test -s /opt/mb/classpath/${v}.txt; \

CMD ["node", "/opt/mb/app/server.js"]
